statements.status_notes: react 16.0.0 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/react/. nbclassic is the legacy Jupyter Notebook compatibility shim; the default UI shipped by this image is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own (newer) react and does not load nbclassic's bundled copy. The renderToStaticMarkup XSS path runs in the user's browser only if the user opts into the classic /tree UI, and only with notebook content the user themselves authored or chose to open.
